description.main_subject: Urban street scene with people and motorbikes
description.detailed_description: A vibrant street scene unfolds in a sunlit urban environment, featuring a scooter carrying two individuals moving away from the viewer down a narrow road. The street is flanked by multi-story buildings adorned with plants and awnings, with numerous parked motorbikes lining the sidewalks. Bright natural light illuminates the scene, creating a lively and authentic atmosphere of daily city life.
